svg.title: Relational schema 3/5: Provenance, supplements and forecasts
svg.desc: Relational schema 3 of five: Provenance, supplements and forecasts. Clark Figure 8.14 notation: gray horizontal attribute rows, uppercase relation names, underlined primary-key components and black foreign-key arrows pointing to referenced columns. Each composite foreign key has one branching connector and one shared trunk; column order is recorded in metadata and the relational schema dictionary. Full rows labeled cross-sheet reference repeat a relation from its principal sheet, not another stored relation. Types, nullability, UNIQUE and CHECK constraints are in relational-schema.md.
